rules: ranks start at 1 and every candidate receives one
component and fused ties break by ascending numeric tv_show_id
a seeded user's unreachable candidates rank after reachable ones by ascending id
a user with no training positive takes the common popularity fallback
selection_rule: highest main-validation primary MAP@5 among PPR alone and the four hybrids; a hybrid within 1e-12 of PPR loses to the simpler PPR strategy; the stability fold cannot override this
